name: cipher-trace
description: End-to-end encrypted document provenance and approval platform

scripts.audit: bun run deps:policy:check && bun audit --audit-level=high && uv lock --check && uv run pip check
scripts.coverage:build: bun run coverage:typescript && bun run coverage:python && bun run coverage:render && bun run coverage:render:pdf
scripts.coverage:publish: bun run coverage:typescript && bun run coverage:python && bun scripts/publish/publish-coverage.ts
scripts.coverage:python: uv run pytest --cov=apps/api/app --cov=cipher_trace_core --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=95 && uv run python -m coverage lcov -o coverage/python.lcov && bun scripts/coverage/check-python-coverage.ts
scripts.verify: bun run verify:ts && bun run audit && bun run codeql:scan && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy && bun run coverage:python
scripts.verify:ts: bun run naming:check && bun run toolchain:check && bun run check:ts && bun run build:web && bun run coverage:typescript
